title: An Unwanted Repayment
overview: A frail young lady finds herself kidnapped. Her only hope is to win over a man hired to kill her.

title: Tennyo Island
overview: Satoko struggles to keep on her dangerous rescuer's good side while learning about her predicament.

title: A Watchful Rat
overview: Satoko agrees to Shinpei's plan: Become a courtesan and convince a wealthy man to buy her out.

title: I'll Set You Free
overview: Satoko grapples with Shinpei's violent tendencies and her own feelings.

title: Hurt
overview: Shinpei's attentions to Satoko earn her the courtesans' ire.

title: Honest Feelings
overview: Yukari's jealousy tests Satoko's resolve to protect herself, and a friendship masks darker motives.
